Chart.js vendored files for EPlusSimple Launcher

Version: chart.js 4.4.9
Source package: npm chart.js@4.4.9
License: MIT

Recommended path:
  tools/go/cmd/eplussimple-launcher/frontend/assets/vendor/

Files:
  chart.umd.js          Original file from package/dist/chart.umd.js
  chart.umd.min.js      Same content, alias for existing index.html paths
  LICENSE.chartjs.md    Chart.js MIT license text

Recommended cleanup:
  If index.html loads ./assets/vendor/chart.umd.min.js, keep chart.umd.min.js.
  If index.html loads ./assets/vendor/chart.umd.js, keep chart.umd.js.
  Keeping both is harmless but redundant.
